frontier_selector.why: The linear, soft-tissue lesion and homogeneous mass isodense to muscle without infiltration of adjacent structures specifically support Conjunctival Amyloidosis.

support_spans: a linear, soft-tissue lesion was noted centrally along the lower conjunctival fornix of the right eye
the mass appeared pinkish-yellow rather than the typical salmon pink of lymphoid lesions
Orbital computed tomography demonstrated a purely conjunctival, homogeneous mass isodense to muscle without infiltration of adjacent structures
